Airhole: many tiny round pinholes scattered on a smooth grey surface
small circular bubble marks with dark centers and clean rounded rims
dense shallow air pores like dots, without long lines or exposed stones
clusters of millimeter scale round holes left by trapped air bubbles
Crack: a thin dark jagged line crossing the surface
a narrow branching fracture with sharp irregular edges
a continuous hairline split that cuts through the grey material
long black linear fissures, not round pits or missing chunks
Exposed reinforcement: rust colored steel bars visible through broken cover
ribbed metal rebar exposed inside a damaged opening
linear brown or metallic reinforcement crossing an uncovered area
steel rods showing beneath the surface with surrounding broken cover
Formwork deformation: broad warped bulges or depressions left by bent form panels
large smooth undulations where the molded face is bent out of plane
curved swelling and sagging surface geometry without a sharp joint step
wide distorted molded texture caused by a deformed casting board
Formwork misalignment: a straight offset seam where two cast panels meet at different levels
sharp step line along a formwork joint with one side raised
linear panel boundary with displaced planes and mismatched edges
abrupt vertical or horizontal ledge caused by shifted form panels
Honeycombing: coarse aggregate stones exposed in an open porous honeycomb area
large connected cavities with gravel visible and missing cement paste
rough clustered voids around aggregate, forming a sponge like texture
irregular deep pockets with exposed stones rather than smooth pinholes
Inclusions: foreign debris embedded in the surface with a different color or texture
isolated contaminant patch such as wood, plastic, soil, or loose material
non concrete object trapped inside the hardened surface
small alien material inclusion contrasting against the grey background
Missing edge: broken corner or edge with a chunk missing from the boundary
chipped border where the outer outline is incomplete
lost material along the rim producing an irregular notch
damaged external edge with a fractured corner and open boundary
Mortar leakage: thin pale slurry streaks flowing from a form joint
cement paste leakage stains forming drips or raised ridges
runny mortar traces along seams with smeared light grey residue
extruded paste marks and leakage trails outside the intended joint
Pitting surface: many shallow irregular depressions giving a rough speckled finish
fine surface pockmarks spread across the face without deep cavities
small non circular pits and rough texture from poor finishing
widespread shallow pitted texture distinct from bubble pinholes
Seepage: dark wet stains spreading downward from water leakage
damp discoloration patches with moisture marks on the surface
water seep trails, streaks, or tide marks on the grey face
localized wet glossy area indicating liquid penetration
Voids: large empty holes or hollow pockets with dark interiors
deep isolated cavities much bigger than pinholes
open gaps where material is absent, forming visible empty space
single or multiple large void openings with shadowed inner walls
